name: Raycast social card — dark command palette OG image by raycast.com
description: A 1200×630 social card that reads as one vertical stack on a near-black stage: centered wordmark, a single oversized gradient headline, and a command-palette app window that bleeds off the bottom edge. All colour is environmental — diagonal red light streaks rake across the backdrop and rim-light the window's border, so the UI itself stays monochrome glass. Focal hierarchy is achieved purely through scale and position: type at the top does the talking, the product shot below proves it.
